strategy_roster.name: Bullish & Bearish Harami Stochastic
strategy_roster.entry_long: high <= donchian_high_prev(high,1) and low >= donchian_low_prev(low,1) and close > open and rsi(close,14) < 30
strategy_roster.notes: The harami is expressed as an inside bullish body (current range within the prior bar) with the documented OversoldLevel 30 confirmation and the 20/80 ExitLower/ExitUpper thresholds close the trade. Stochastic %K/%D and the 47/9/13 smoothings are unavailable, so RSI(14) stands in for %D and the MovingAveragePeriod=5 body filter is not represented.

strategy_roster.name: Grid Trading at Volatile Market
strategy_roster.entry_long: high > donchian_high_prev(high,50) and close > open and close > sma(close,50)
strategy_roster.notes: The higher-timeframe Donchian boundary is approximated by a 50-bar channel (SlowMaLength=50 filter retained) and the engulfing confirmation by a bullish close at the boundary. GridMultiplier averaging, TakeProfitFactor and MaxDrawdownFraction are portfolio-level controls on a single net position.

strategy_roster.name: Tomas Ratio Strategy with Multi-Timeframe Analysis
strategy_roster.notes: The weighted multi-timeframe gain/loss ratio is approximated by a one-standard-deviation deviation over the documented DeviationLength=168 above the documented EMA(720), and the close-points-exceed-buy-points exit is replaced by losing the trend anchor. PointsTarget=100 and the multi-timeframe accumulation are not single-series fields.

strategy_roster.name: Take Profit Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Strictly rising highs over the four Shift candles become a close above the prior four-bar high and rising opens become a positive four-bar open return, which is the documented long momentum sequence. TrailingStopPoints, partial 50% closes, the account equity target and risk-percent sizing are execution and account fields; StopLossPoints=0 disables the stop.

strategy_roster.name: Currency Momentum Factor
strategy_roster.notes: The factor ranks a cross-section of currency pairs by 252-day momentum and rebalances monthly, which yields no single-instrument market signal, and the sample is documented as lacking a real momentum calculation. Universe, K, MinTradeUsd and the monthly schedule are portfolio/calendar constructs.

strategy_roster.name: US 30 Daily Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: On daily bars the prior bar is the previous session, so a close above its high is exactly the documented single long breakout and the mirrored low close exits. TakeProfitPips/StopLossPips of 50 are pip distances and cannot be expressed as percentage fields; the once-per-day rule is inherent to the daily series.

strategy_roster.name: 21-Hour Session Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: Entries are pending stop orders bracketing the quote at the 08:00 and 22:00 session starts with positions force-closed at 21:00/23:00, so the logic is purely clock- and quote-based with no market-derived signal to translate. StepPoints, TakeProfitPoints, Volume and the hourly schedule are not DSL fields.

strategy_roster.name: Bill Williams Wise Man 2
strategy_roster.notes: The Awesome Oscillator is approximated with SMA(5)-SMA(34) on close, with the documented three-lower-bars-after-a-peak replaced by a negative three-bar change while AO stays above zero, and the mirror trough signal reverses the long. Peak/trough confirmation and the 4-hour timeframe are not available on one series; the docs specify no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Alligator Simple
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,5) > ema(close,8) and ema(close,8) > ema(close,13) and roc(ema(close,5),1) > 0 and roc(ema(close,13),1) > 0
strategy_roster.notes: SMMA lips/teeth/jaw are approximated by EMA(5)/EMA(8)/EMA(13) with the documented lengths, and the entry requires the lines stacked and expanding upward; the jaw/EMA crossover exit mirrors the documented flip. The 8/5/3 forward shifts, the previous-bar read and the 100-pip stop, target and trailing are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Fibonacci TP SL
strategy_roster.entry_long: close <= donchian_high(high,100) - 0.382 * (donchian_high(high,100) - donchian_low(low,100)) and close >= donchian_high(high,100) - 0.786 * (donchian_high(high,100) - donchian_low(low,100))
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 38.2/78.6 percent entry band is rebuilt from the Lookback=100 high/low range and the exit is the 23.6 percent retracement as a mean-reversion completion. The documented Take Profit % of 4 is applied as the percentage target; the ATR(14) x1.5 stop, the 10-bar trade gap and the 15% weekly cap are not percentage fields.
